config.title: Lander NEAT 98
config.goal_text: on 1,000 unseen flights, then again on a second 1,000 (boulder layout v3; goal lowered from 98% to 95% by the user on 2026-11-01)

runs.note: Run N1: NEAT from random genomes (16 -> 32 random tanh hidden -> 4; NEAT adds and deletes nodes and connections freely), population 300, ~12 species. Every genome of a generation flies the same seeds; the top 10 re-fly 40 selection seeds. Pay: 0.3 x game score + 300 per landing - 200 per timeout - 100 per boulder touch. Stop when the champion lands >= 95% (200 real-task flights, then 1,000 fresh selection flights), or Friday 2026-11-06 17:00. Changed at gen 220: ramps are paced by the champion's landing rate, stage 2 mixes in 25% small-boulder flights, and the stage's final world is checked every 10 generations from the start (it can only pass once the ramp is done).
